summary: Sam Pitroda founded C-DAC after returning to India in 1984. He is the Public Information Infrastructure and Innovation Advisor to the Indian Prime Minister, aiming to make citizen facilities effective and prepare an innovation roadmap. He is also Chairman of the National Innovation Council. From 2005 to 2009, he chaired the Knowledge Commission of India, offering about 300 suggestions in 27 areas. Pitroda holds a Master's in Electronics from the Illinois Institute of Technology in Chicago and worked in telecommunications and computing in the sixties and seventies.
